summary: Polaryx Therapeutics, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 1, 2026, reporting the appointment of Will Charlton, M.D., M.A.S., as Chief Medical Officer, effective September 1, 2026. The filing is a routine executive appointment announcement under Items 7.01 and 8.01, with a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. Dr. Charlton's background includes prior roles at Tyra Biosciences, Spruce Biosciences, and 89bio. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed. The filing is informational only and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
